items.name: 副调节器
items.definition: 串级控制系统中的副调节器，传递函数为Gc2(s)。

items.name: Undamped natural frequency omega n
items.definition: Undamped natural frequency omega n：The undamped natural frequency is the radius at which the poles are located in the s-plane.

items.name: Fast pole and slow pole
items.definition: Fast pole and slow pole：Fast poles and slow poles refer to relative rate of signal decay.

items.name: Resonant peak
items.definition: Resonant peak：The maximum value of the frequency-response magnitude.
